tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I need to roll back the payments service due to errors since this morning's deploy, but the system doesn't recognize the name. I tried "payments", "payment", "payments-service", and "payment-service" — all returned "Unknown service". What is the exact registered service name for payments?

trace.question: I need to roll back the payments service due to errors since this morning's deploy, but the system doesn't recognize the name. I tried "payments", "payment", "payments-service", and "payment-service" — all returned "Unknown service". What is the exact registered service name for payments?

trace.message: It's payments-worker - the API errors are downstream of the worker.

args.summary: The v3.4.0 deploy of payments-worker (this morning) caused an 18% error rate and unhealthy status across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), resulting in downstream payments API errors. Rolled back to v3.3.0 (last healthy release) across all production regions. Service is now healthy with error rate at 0.2%. v3.4.0 should be investigated before any future redeploy.
args.title: payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy caused elevated errors; rolled back to v3.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service**: The name `payments` wasn't recognized; after checking with you, confirmed it's `payments-worker` (the API errors are downstream of the worker).
2. **Diagnosed the issue**: v3.4.0 (this morning's deploy) was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The last healthy release was **v3.3.0**.
3. **Rolled back**: Deployed v3.3.0 to all production regions. Verified the service is now **healthy** with the error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: **INC-0001** — "payments-worker v3.4.0 deploy caused elevated errors; rolled back to v3.3.0". On-call has been paged.

Note: v3.4.0 has never been healthy in production, so any attempt to redeploy it (or a fix built from it) will require change-manager approval per policy.
